reponse:
Martin flagged two things on the Nov 12 sync. One is fixed. The other was picked up, but the answer is bad news for Tradewell.

**1. Webhook signatures failing on sandbox.** Ellen Vance said payout.paid and seller.verified events failed verification about 95% of the time, and Tradewell had turned verification off on sandbox [1].
- Jake Whitfield took it on the call [1]. He found that we were signing a re-serialized body instead of the bytes we actually send [2][3].
- The fix (core#1187) is merged and deployed to sandbox, and goes to production with release 2026.47 on Tue Nov 24 [4][5].
- On Nov 17, Ellen confirmed she had turned verification back on, and 300+ events had verified [3].
- One thing to check: production still needs the Nov 24 release, which is 13 days before Dec 7.

**2. Per-seller payout schedules.** Tradewell wants net-7 for about 200 top sellers and net-30 for the rest. Today Quillon only supports one schedule per platform [1].
- Owen Park told Martin he would take it to product and engineering, and promised a clear answer by Friday Nov 20 [3].
- Tomer Golan estimated 3–4 weeks of work, including testing and a dry run with Corvane [6].
- Avi Kessler's reply is that the earliest delivery is late January. He moved the ticket (QPAY-2362) to Backlog with a 2027-Q1 target, and asked Owen to set expectations with Martin [6].
- I found no sign yet that Owen has told Martin. That's the open item, and Martin said his sellers need to know what happens in December [1].
